description:
List circular-economy opportunities inferred from the customer's OWN stored business profile: for each, the flow, asset, spare capacity or capability it rests on and the kind of company that completes it. Does not run a discovery and does not cost credits. The list is dated by `computed_at` — when it was DERIVED, not when you asked — and is never padded, so an empty list means nothing is well-grounded.

READ `speech_act` BEFORE YOU USE A LABEL. Each of `resource` and `counterpart` carries one, graded independently. `ASSERT` means the customer told us this and you may state it back. `ASK` means WE INFERRED IT, so refer to it only as a question ('do you have spare kiln capacity?'), never as a fact ('your spare kiln capacity').

The two elements are NOT the same kind of claim. `resource` is about the customer's OWN business; `counterpart` is a hypothesis about which kind of company would want it, and it is `ASK` on nearly every entry — that is normal and does not make the entry unusable.

`outreach_draft_eligible` answers ONE question: may this entry ground a draft at all. It turns on the `resource`, because that is what a message would be ABOUT. `false` means do not compose outreach from it in any form, not even as a question. `true` means you may write about the resource — it does NOT license asserting the `counterpart`; that element's own `speech_act` still governs it, so write the market as an open question, not as a need you have established.

Do not re-order the list: the order is server-authoritative and shared with every other surface these opportunities appear on. Pass an entry's `handle` to run_circular_opportunity to search for its counterparts.
name: list_circular_opportunities
title: List circular opportunities
